title: Grant and disable product access on an account
description:
As an operator, I want to turn a product such as Cyclotron Lab on or off for an account.

Feature: Grant and disable product access on an account
  Scenario: Grant a product
    Given an account and an authorized operator
    When the operator grants a registered product
    Then the account gains that product's entitlement with audit history and revision checks

  Scenario: Disable a product
    Given an account with an active product entitlement
    When the operator disables it
    Then that product's authorize calls are denied and no data is deleted

Today an account only receives the product it was created from. Who may grant products needs Ryan's approval before activation.
